short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 393 recent saved-signal files and 169 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around @patrickc: Detroit impressions: • The downtown is full of beautiful buildings. All of them seem... and Donate to Jesus Olivas, plus 5 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Mix: 35. Japanese Healing Music.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-25. Use poster crop with side-lit object slab; make A large off-white polygonal slab enters from the upper left and cuts diagonally into a mint-green field, with one soft blurred edge rather than a crisp poster border. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against overexposed diagonal light slab, sharp diagonal shadow edge, and right vertical paper seam.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
